meta.name: Demand
meta.description: Demandinvestigates the commercial sex trade, across four countries: The United States, Netherlands, Japan, and Jamaica. The film reveals a harrowing first-hand account of the impact of soaring consumer demand for vulnerable women and children, to be victimised in sex trafficking markets. By exploring the entrenched connections of pornography, to widespread sexual assault, to a pervasive globalised human trafficking market,Demandquestions the conditions that keep the inertia of the commercial sex trade roaring across the globe…
